newsitem.title: CHINA: China says studying Vietnam suggestions on oil.
newsitem.headline: China says studying Vietnam suggestions on oil.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it was studying suggestions from Vietnam, which has called for an immediate and unconditional meeting with Beijing in a territorial and oil exploration row.
"We are currently studying Vietnam's other proposals," a Foreign Ministry spokesman said at a news briefing when asked about the row with Vietnam.
"On conflicts with other countries, China's principled stance is always to resolve them through peaceful consultations," the spokesman said when pressed for a response on the dispute with Hanoi.

Vietnam's communist government turned up the heat this week in its territorial and oil exploration row with its giant northern neighbour, accusing China of violating international laws and calling for urgent talks.

Amid signs of growing official frustration, a foreign ministry spokesman in Hanoi said China's decision to position an oil rig off Vietnam's central coast in early March could not be left to routine border discussion channels.
